findings.title: An unbound assertion is ignored and the actual host cohort becomes PASS
findings.target: runtime/recipe/assert-capture.mjs assertCapture, invoked by actual host.runJobs
findings.minimalMutation: Clone the authenticated CMD-01 materialized job; retain its expected bytes/status and add expected.assertions = ['UNBOUND_INDEPENDENT_ASSERTION_MUST_NOT_GREEN'].
findings.observation: A regular synthetic child supplies a valid CAPTURED envelope with the expected CMD-01 bytes. The actual assertCapture callback ignores the additional assertion. The actual runJobs summary is aggregate PASS, with no failures, integrity true, reapProof true and exitCode 0.
findings.expected: An unknown assertion must not turn green; refuse it or retain an explicit unfulfilled obligation rather than treating it as satisfied.
findings.qualification: This is an in-memory job mutation at the real assertion/host seam, not a modification of the committed 194-ID recipe or a demonstrated bypass of execute.mjs authorization. The unmodified inventory already discloses partial records; this finding does not rescore those records. The raw synthetic cohort PASS is preserved, not rewritten to the expected FAIL.

findings.title: Reason capture collapses distinct equal-looking object identities
findings.minimalMutation: Encode one plain object twice and a distinct plain object with the same name/message once; no product or private hook is involved.
findings.observation: All three encodings are identical objects containing kind/name/message/code/stack, with no identity token. The same-reference and different-reference cases cannot be distinguished. undefined, null and false remain distinct and passed their control.
findings.expected: ER-03 reason capture must preserve stable object identity where observed; equal printed properties are not identity evidence.
findings.qualification: This limits identity-sensitive rejection/cleanup evidence. It is not a demonstrated product cancellation defect, nor a claim that the still-pending lifecycle adapter was executed.
